result.summary: Found 2 visual issues, mainly a prominent overlay/glitch in the bottom navigation and minor right-edge clipping from horizontal carousel content.

issues.description: A black horizontal bar is incorrectly positioned across the bottom navigation area, overlapping the Search and Saved/Bookmark icons. It looks like a misplaced gesture/home indicator or rendering artifact.
issues.suggestion: Move the gesture/home indicator outside the app navigation area or adjust the bottom safe-area padding so it sits below the tab bar and does not obscure icons.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrollable items are visibly clipped at the right edge, including a category chip and restaurant cards. This may be intentional carousel behavior, but the clipped text/card content can look abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel spacing, partial-card treatment, or fade/peek styling so the clipping feels intentional and does not cut important text.
